scripts.test:gpt: pnpm run test:gpt-chat && pnpm run test:gpt-protocol
scripts.dev:full: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline PRIVATE_ADD=true vite build --watch
scripts.dev:private: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline PRIVATE_ADD=true PRIVATE_REMOVE=true vite build --watch
scripts.build:private: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PRIVATE_ADD=true PRIVATE_REMOVE=true vite build
scripts.build:srcmap: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PRIVATE_ADD=true VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline PRIVATE_REMOVE=true vite build
scripts.build:analyze-private: cross-env ANALYZE_BUNDLE=true NODE_ENV=production PRIVATE_ADD=true PRIVATE_REMOVE=true vite build
scripts.make-install: pnpm run build && npx --package siyuan-plugin-cli make-install
scripts.make-install:srcmap: pnpm run build:srcmap && npx --package siyuan-plugin-cli make-install
scripts.make-install:private: pnpm run build:private && npx --package siyuan-plugin-cli make-install
